name: devdrop
description: DevDrop — local-network file sharing between Windows PC and Android over LAN

scripts.devdrop:stop: powershell -Command "$c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4545 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -gt 0 }; if ($c) { Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host '✓ DevDrop server stopped.' } else { Write-Host 'DevDrop server is not running.' }"
